# Copilot Instructions for WaveTone

- Scaffolded as a MERN (MongoDB, Express, React, Node.js) + WebRTC + Socket.io project.
- Use the provided color palette for a modern, dark UI.
- Pages: Home, Browse Rooms, Create Room, Join Room, Voice Room, Post-Room Summary, About/Rules.
- Backend: Express.js, MongoDB, Socket.io for signaling, room/session management.
- Frontend: React, navigation, placeholder components for all flows.
- No AI features yet; moderation logic is stubbed.
- Follow the checklist in this file for systematic development and documentation.
